scope: Rust-only fixed-scope session and native accepted-work lifetime; not Tauri/TypeScript binding or desktop parity

implementation.authority: Host-only trusted SpaceKey creates dedicated owner and lease; method payloads only docId/update
implementation.admission: Synchronous admission/closing gate; 64 accepted calls, 64 MiB update input bytes rounded to 64 KiB
implementation.cancellation: Accepted operation and admission survive cancellation of its external waiter
implementation.close: Stops admission, drains accepted native work, revokes dedicated owner, shares a stable result with concurrent/repeated/cancelled waiters
implementation.failure: Host-side external revocation yields stable UNAUTHORIZED; join failure maps TASK, not success
implementation.drop: Best-effort async cleanup only; explicit awaited close with live runtime is required

verification.format: passed; existing nightly-only configuration warnings retained
verification.dependencyAudit: normal/build graph excludes napi, napi-derive and napi-build
verification.multithread: Accepted write draining, cancelled close waiter and cancelled-read capacity cases run on a two-thread Tokio runtime; no sleeps
verification.immediateCleanup: Root close/reopen plus immediate remove_dir_all asserted without retries

limitations: No TypeScript TrustedStorageSession implementation, Tauri commands, native main-frame authorization, Worker bridge or editor integration.
Lower-level SQLite close returns no error result; stable external-revocation failure is not simulated disk/flush failure evidence.
Runtime/process shutdown, stuck native work, panic recovery, leaked references and host navigation/reload/close wiring remain open.
Per-session operation/input budgets do not bound merged reads, stored growth, response serialization or aggregate sessions/queues.
No snapshot/subscription transport, blobs, full StoreManager API, migration, power-loss or application restart acceptance.
Windows/macOS extension results pending; previous library evidence remains separate.
review: Host-agent OCR-rule review, not independent code review/security audit
